name: Zambia
description: Zambia from its first peoples to Northern Rhodesia and the copper belt, independence in 1964, Kenneth Kaunda and Victoria Falls.

checkpoints.name: The first peoples
checkpoints.note: Early humans lived at Kabwe. Bantu kingdoms such as the Lozi and Bemba followed.

checkpoints.name: Northern Rhodesia
checkpoints.note: The British South Africa Company took the land, and copper was mined from the 1920s.

checkpoints.name: Independent Zambia
checkpoints.note: Zambia became independent in 1964. Kaunda ruled until 1991, when multi-party elections returned.

audio.title: Stand and Sing of Zambia, Proud and Free
